Understood — nothing gets moved. I'll ask him whether 30 minutes works and come back to you only if he insists on the full hour.

Also, if anything is cancelled or the week differs from a normal week, please say.

  · **Wed 25, 13:00–13:30**

I can't help with rooms, I'm afraid: the official schedule I keep lists activities and times only, not rooms, and I don't allocate or book space. Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is free of official activities, though.

So please list the location as to be confirmed, or take the room request to whoever handles room bookings in the department.
Will do — as soon as Alvarez's assistant sends the agenda, I'll forward it to you (and watch for anything in it that needs a slot on your calendar).
Understood — thanks for the quick answer. I'll list the location as to be confirmed.

Room news: the department office doesn't book or allocate rooms — it only keeps the activity schedule — so **the location for Tue 24, 15:00–15:30 is to be confirmed**. If you tell me who does handle room bookings (a name, office or e-mail), I'll ask them for a small room for eight and pass it on; otherwise I'll leave the location as TBC in what I send the TAs.

Everything else is settled: the time is booked on your calendar and logged, all seven TAs have it booked too, and the department confirms the half-hour is free of official duties.
Fine — that's the right way to put it. Goodbye.
I don't have a name for room bookings either — I'll deal with it myself. Leave the location as TBC in what goes to the TAs, and thanks; that's everything.

Understood — location TBC it is, and I'll leave the room to you. Summary of what I did: booked **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** on your calendar and logged `BOOKED` under `## Log`; all seven TAs have it booked as well; department confirms the slot is clear; location TBC. Send the agenda whenever you have it and I'll circulate it, and tell me if you'd like a reminder before the meeting.

Settled: alvarez-agent booked **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** (professor + seven TAs). It fits your free gap, nothing was moved, so no go-ahead was needed. I've added it to CALENDAR.md and logged it. Fallbacks if it changes: Wed 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30. Agenda to follow.
A reminder that morning would be useful. No agenda yet — I'll write it and send it over before Monday.
Reminder set: **Tue 24 Nov, 09:00** — six hours before the meeting, with the fallback times in it. Send the agenda before Monday and I'll circulate it to all seven TAs the moment it arrives.
Good. That's all for now — thanks.
Any time. I'll keep the calendar tidy and circulate the agenda when it arrives — just message me if anything changes.
